The '''Primal Destroyer''' was a massive [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]] that had been imprisoned in the depths of [[the Tomb]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] until it was released during the [[invasion of Belsavis]]. It made its home in the [[Ancient Stasis Zone]], in a shallow lake that became known as the [[Waters of the Primal Destroyer]], until it was eventually [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Primal Destroyer appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the World Boss on Belsavis. It is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means it was killed.<ref name="TOR" />
